distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) treated the historical Taiwan attribution as doubtful. The species was otherwise known from the Philippines; a single Shiraki specimen labelled Kankau (Pingtung) was considered insufficient confirmation. No confirmed Taiwan occurrence is promoted.

host_note: No host evidence is reported for this doubtful Taiwan record; no host is promoted from Beaver & Liu (2010).
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Diamerus puncticollis Eggers, 1927.

taxonomic_history.name: Diamerus puncticollis

nomenclature_note: Current identity is Diamerus puncticollis Eggers, 1927, VSN_2358. The uncertainty concerns Taiwan occurrence, not taxon identity.
